subject: Clarify BYOK scope & retention carve-outs for Orchard Health POC
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam@orchardhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: privacy@orchardhealth.com; legal@orchardhealth.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Security questions for POC (BYOK + retention)

Hi Karthik — thanks again for the demo last week. We have a short internal checklist we need answered before we can spin up the POC in our environment:

- We need confirmation that customer-managed keys (BYOK/KMS) can be used for ephemeral model caching and long-term logs separately.
- Retention: we have a 30-day rolling retention requirement for any request/response logs used for debugging, but a separate 7-year retention for audit trails in certain jurisdictions — do you support per-log-class retention rules?
- SSO: we'd like to know how you map identities to audit events when requests are proxied via our platform.

Attached is a short PDF of our audit matrix (Orchard_Audit_Req_v2.pdf). Can you loop in the right people at Redwood and confirm the parts that are blockers for us?

Thanks,
Sam Park
Director, IT Security
Orchard Health

-----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sam Park <sam@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; neha_kapoor@redwood.ai; marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Security questions for POC (BYOK + retention)

Sam — thanks, got the matrix. Looping in Neha (security) and Marcus (product) to triage. A few high-level notes from me before you dive deeper:

- BYOK: Redwood Private supports customer KMS for data-at-rest; we can also attach a customer-managed key to long-term audit logs. Ephemeral in-GPU caches currently use host-managed keys, but we have a short-term roadmap to expose a per-tenant KMS wrapping option. Will confirm timing/constraints below.
- Retention policies: we support multiple retention classes today (transient debug logs vs. immutable audit events). Per-log-class retention rules are supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted customers currently get configurable retention windows but not per-event-class immutable retention beyond archive exports.
- SSO mapping: we emit token-level metadata and an identity_id field derived from the principal in the auth header (OIDC Subject). We can add additional mapping if you need on-prem attribute enrichment.

Neha/Marcus — can you take a pass on the attached matrix and flag any hard blockers for an Orchard POC? Laura — capture next steps with Sam and include estimated ETA for BYOK feature if we need to accelerate.

— Karthik
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference

-----
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Security questions for POC (BYOK + retention)

Thanks Karthik — quick triage notes from Security:

1) BYOK for long-term logs: supported on Private (customer KMS). No blocker. We will need Key ARN + rotation policy during onboarding.

2) BYOK for ephemeral GPU KV cache: current runtime uses host KMS to avoid perf regressions and key-churn risk. To support per-tenant BYOK for KV cache we need:
   - A small design change to expose a wrapping key path in the runtime (low-risk but requires QA across multi-tenant encrypt/decrypt hot paths).
   - Ops changes for key permissions and emergency rotation procedures.
   - Estimated timeline: 6–8 weeks if we prioritize; 12+ weeks otherwise. Potential workaround: we can enable end-to-end encryption of the KV cache in transit and rely on host KMS for encryption-at-rest, combined with tenant-side re-encryption of exported logs.

3) Per-log-class retention: product supports retention buckets. However, immutable audit trails for 7-year legal retention currently require export-to-cold-storage (S3/GCS) under customer-managed lifecycle, rather than in-place vaulting on hosted tiers. That means for Orchard POC we can:
   - Option A (Private): enforce immutable retention in-place, using customer KMS and retention policy.
   - Option B (Hosted w/ export): configure a pipeline to export audit events to Orchard S3 with lifecycle + KMS key.

4) Identity mapping: we can include OIDC claims in audit events. If Orchard wants AD attributes (e.g., employee_id), we need a mapping agreed in onboarding and a short attribute-translation webhook (1–2 sprint effort).

Attachments referenced: "POC-MMAP-byok-sample-config.yaml" is a sample config we should share during onboarding docs.

Neha
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

-----
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; neha_kapoor@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; Sam Park <sam@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Security questions for POC (BYOK + retention)

Sam, thanks for the clear list. Adding implementation/roadmap context:

- For the POC we recommend Option B from Neha: spin up the POC on Hosted but configure audit-exports to Orchard S3 with your KMS. That avoids changing the runtime for the POC and meets your 30-day debug+7-year archive requirement via export lifecycle.
- We can provide a small connector (lambda-based) and a sample policy to automate exports. That connector will sample and sign events during the POC so you have integrity guarantees while we work on native immutable retention.
- If Orchard requires BYOK for live KV cache for compliance reasons (legal hold on production in-region), we should scope the runtime change as an accelerated ticket. Marcus to estimate and propose a short plan in 48 hours.

Next steps request for Redwood -> Orchard:
1) Laura, please propose two calendar slots for a technical onboarding (30–45 min) to walk through the export pipeline and KMS config.
2) Sam, confirm if Orchard can accept exported audit events into a pre-provisioned S3 bucket with customer KMS. If so, share bucket ARN and KMS key ARN.
3) Security to confirm acceptable interim controls for POC (signed export + replay audit).

— Marcus
VP Product
Redwood Inference

Sam — please reply with preferred slot and whether you can provision an S3 bucket with customer KMS for exports. If you prefer Private deployment instead, let me know and I’ll get procurement involved for an accelerated pilot.

Best,
Laura Bennett
